insights.summary: Customers want dashboards delivered to Looker, Google Sheets or BI tools on a schedule instead of manual CSV exports.
insights.quote: so if there was a way to schedule that delivery instead of me hand-carrying it that would give me back most of a day a week

insights.summary: When the AI Voice Agent transfers to a live agent, the details it collected do not arrive, so callers repeat themselves.
insights.quote: but my supervisors tell me the reps have basically stopped looking for the details. they just open the call and start over
